title: Wholesome Girlies vs Flo for Women Trying to Conceive
description: Compare Wholesome Girlies and Flo for trying to conceive. See what each lets you track, what it costs in Nigeria and where it keeps your dates.
share: If you are choosing between Flo and Wholesome Girlies, this comparison shows what each app lets you do, what it costs in Nigeria and where it keeps your dates.
kicker: For women choosing a tracker while trying to conceive
answer: If you want to note symptoms every day and get reminders, use Flo. If you want to see fertile days without signing up, use the Wholesome Girlies calculator. You can also print clinic questions and send your partner his checklist. No calendar app can tell you the exact day you ovulate, ours included. Ours counts from your last period, and we show the count below.

rows.label: Do I have to sign up?
rows.wg: No. Open the Period Tracker or Ovulation Calculator and type your date. Sign in with your email only if you want your programs and streak on another phone.
rows.other: No, if you use Anonymous Mode. Sign up if you want your Flo entries on your other devices.

rows.label: What does it cost me?
rows.wg: The tools need no card. The Trying-to-Conceive Blueprint is ₦5,700 early-bird (₦13,700 standard), paid once. Buyers abroad pay $12 early-bird ($27 standard).
rows.other: On Android in Nigeria, Premium has no charge for one year under Pass It On. On iPhone, it costs ₦3,900 (about $3) to ₦29,900 (about $22).

rows.label: Where are my dates kept?
rows.wg: They stay on your phone. Tap the forget button when you want to clear them.
rows.other: Flo keeps them on its servers and protects them with encryption. Flo says it has never sold user data and earns money from subscriptions only.

rows.label: Does it learn my cycle length?
rows.wg: After three logged period starts, the tracker uses your own average from your last six gaps. It skips any gap under 18 days or over 60 days as a missed log.
rows.other: Flo uses the cycle dates you enter and its own calculation. Flo says its predictions improve as you enter more dates.

rows.label: What happens when I change phone?
rows.wg: Save one backup file in the Girlies app, then restore it on your new phone. If you sign in with your email, your programs, streak and reading place follow you too. Your dates do not.
rows.other: Sign in to your Flo account to see your entries on another device.

rows.label: Does it speak to Nigerian women?
rows.wg: Yes. You see naira and dollar prices and advice for a Nigerian clinic visit.
rows.other: Flo writes for women worldwide. Nigeria is included in its Pass It On Project.

rows.label: Does it guide me while I try?
rows.wg: The Trying-to-Conceive Blueprint has five parts. It covers your cycle, preparing, your partner, tests and the wait.
rows.other: You can read a large collection of articles.

rows.label: Can I prepare for my clinic visit?
rows.wg: Tick your questions, add your own, print the list and take it to the clinic.
rows.other: Use the Symptom Checker and read the Health Library before your visit.

rows.label: Can my partner use it too?
rows.wg: Send him His Fertility Checklist. He can tick each step himself.
rows.other: Flo for Partners lets you share medical information and tips with him.

rows.label: Can I talk to other women?
rows.wg: Anyone can join our open Telegram group for tips, polls and app help. Blueprint buyers also get the private Conception community for life.
rows.other: Secret Chats lets women talk in a moderated group. Flo says 7 million members use it each month.

rows.label: Can I note symptoms and get reminders?
rows.wg: You cannot note symptoms. Tap Add to my calendar under your result. Your next three periods, your fertile days and your likely ovulation day go into your phone calendar, with a reminder 2 days before.
rows.other: Yes. You can note symptoms and ask Flo to remind you.

rows.label: How much can I read and keep?
rows.wg: You get six fertility tools and our fertility guides.
rows.other: Flo has a large collection of articles and about 70 million monthly users by its own count. It keeps the entries you add over time.

wins.b: Open the Ovulation Calculator, type the first day of your last period and pick your cycle length. Your fertile window shows on the same screen. There is no sign-in and no payment step.

wins.h: Your dates stay on your phone
wins.b: Your period dates stay on your phone. We do not receive them. Tap the forget button whenever you want to clear them.

wins.h: Your own average, after three periods
wins.b: Log the first day of each period. After three, the tracker replaces the cycle length you typed with your own average. It uses up to your last six gaps and skips any gap under 18 days or over 60 days as a missed log.

The Girlies app has Save a backup and Restore a backup. Your saved entries go into one file you keep. Sign in with your email and your programs and streak come with you. Once the app is installed, the tools also work with no data.

wins.h: Something short for your cycle day
wins.b: Open the Girlies app and today's card matches your cycle day, in one or two sentences with a link to the tool or guide behind it. Read it, use a tool or finish a game, and your streak goes up by one. Under your tool result, you can also ask for a weekly email for your stage.

wins.h: Written for Nigeria and the diaspora
wins.b: Prices show in naira for Nigerian buyers and in dollars for buyers abroad. The advice fits a clinic visit here: take your last three or four period dates, because a clinician finds them more useful than one calculator result.

wins.h: You know what to do next
wins.b: Pay ₦5,700 early-bird (₦13,700 standard) once, or $12 early-bird ($27 standard) abroad. The Blueprint covers your cycle, preparing, your partner, tests and the wait. You can join the private Conception community for life. The in-app helper explains lessons and tells you when to speak to a doctor.

wins.h: Clinic questions to print, and his own checklist
wins.b: Fertility Appointment Questions lets you tick, add and print. His Fertility Checklist is for your partner to tick himself. Fertility involves both of you.

other_ahead.b: Flo's Secret Chats is a moderated chat space inside the app, and Flo says 7 million members chat there each month. Our open Telegram group and the buyers' Conception community are smaller.

other_ahead.h: You can add symptoms every day
other_ahead.b: Flo lets you note symptoms, sends reminders from the app and shows your entries on your other devices. Our tools save period start dates and can put reminders in your phone calendar, but you cannot note symptoms.

other_ahead.h: A bigger library and a longer history
other_ahead.b: Flo has many articles and about 70 million monthly users by its own count. If you already entered years of dates there, Flo keeps that history. You would start again with our tools.

how.title: How the Wholesome Girlies calculator works
paras: The Ovulation Calculator uses two numbers: the first day of your last period and your usual cycle length. It adds the cycle length to that date to find your next period, then counts back 14 days to estimate the day you ovulate. The fertile window it shows starts five days before that day and ends one day after it.
On a 28-day cycle, day 1 is the first day of your period. Your next period is due on day 29, ovulation is estimated on day 15, and the window runs from day 10 to day 16. That is the whole sum.

A calendar estimates and does not detect. A Journal of Medical Internet Research analysis of 7,043 tracked cycles found that ovulation does not sit reliably at the midpoint of a cycle, and the National Health Service says it usually happens 10 to 16 days before your next period. That limit applies to any calendar method, so we do not claim ours predicts better than Flo's.

faq.q: Does the Wholesome Girlies calculator predict better than Flo?
faq.a: We do not claim that. It sets ovulation 14 days before your next period and the window from five days before to one day after. A Journal of Medical Internet Research analysis of 7,043 tracked cycles found ovulation does not sit reliably at the midpoint. A calendar predicts. It does not detect. Take your last three or four period dates to a clinician.

They stay on your phone. The tools say: Saved only on this phone. Nothing is sent to us. Signing in does not change that, because your account keeps your name, email, programs and streak, never your dates. A forget button clears them, and a backup file moves them to a new phone.

faq.q: Can Wholesome Girlies remind me before my period?
faq.a: Yes, through your own phone calendar. After the Period Tracker or Ovulation Calculator shows your result, tap Add to my calendar. Your next three periods, your fertile days and your likely ovulation day go into your calendar, with a reminder 2 days before. We do not send reminders by push or email.

doctor: See a doctor after twelve months of trying, or six months if you are over 35. See one sooner if your cycles are very irregular, shorter than 21 days or longer than 35, or have stopped. Take your last three or four period dates with you.

disclaimer.strong: This page compares apps. It cannot tell you when you will conceive.
disclaimer.rest: A calendar predicts and does not detect. It is educational, not medical advice, and no clinician has reviewed it yet.
